title: Fen Xiang Valley's secret deal with the Fish-Man Clan
summary: Travelling south, Gui Li stops at a tea stall whose owner is closing because monsters have been coming down from the mountains, in land Fen Xiang Valley has always protected. In Fen Xiang Valley, Li Xun learns that Shangguan Ce is interrogating a demon prisoner again. Gui Li spies on a secret meeting between the Fish-Man Clan and a Fen Xiang elder's men: the fish-men complain that the Dead Swamp hunt for the Heaven Emperor's Death Stone failed and cost them many warriors because the valley's information leaked. They agree to find the Death Stone's location within three days, and Gui Li realises the Valley Master himself may be involved. A fish-man spots him and a fight starts; the fish-men present are killed, and Lu Shun's party carries a body back to the valley. Jin Ping'er then reveals she did the killing to avenge both their men, praises Gui Li's Soul-Devouring Stick against her own Purple Light Sword, and offers to help him get into Fen Xiang Valley if he promises not to strike her down without warning as he did Qin Wuyan. That night the two slip into the valley and are spotted.
events: A tea-stall owner closes up because monsters are attacking people near Fen Xiang land
Shangguan Ce interrogates a demon held for three hundred years; Li Xun visits the valley
Gui Li overhears the Fish-Man Clan and Fen Xiang men discussing the Heaven Emperor's Death Stone
The fish-men agree to report the Death Stone's location in three days; Gui Li suspects the Valley Master
A fight breaks out; the fish-men are killed and their body is taken back to the valley
Jin Ping'er admits she killed them and proposes working with Gui Li
Gui Li and Jin Ping'er sneak into Fen Xiang Valley at night and are discovered
